podcast.title: Sampling of Amen Break
podcast.body: Nightingale is mentioned as one of the artists who have employed the "Amen Break" sample in their music. "And it's been employed by such artists as Slipknot, Primal Scream, Oasis, Nightingale, KMFDM and Literary Thousands more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Unsung Heroes of Music: Part 2

xref.title: Victim of Early Ticket Scalping Scandal (1851)
xref.body: During her 1851 tour of the United States, known as "the Swedish Nightingale," Jenny Lind's tickets quickly disappeared from box offices upon release. These tickets subsequently reappeared in the hands of "sidewalk men," who resold $3 tickets for $6, causing widespread outrage. Rumors of her agent and manager being complicit in the scheme significantly damaged her reputation. "It was rumored that Lind's agent and manager were in on the deal, which greatly damaged your reputation."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
